Struct BoundingBoxI

Namespace
OnixRuntime.Api.Maths
Assembly
OnixRuntime.dll

Represents an axis-aligned bounding box (AABB) in 3D space using integer coordinates, with utility methods for containment, intersection, and manipulation. This implementation is inclusive so Maximum will be included.

public struct BoundingBoxI : IEquatable<BoundingBoxI>, IEnumerable<BlockPos>, IEnumerable
